item.title: Version 1.1.11
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1.11

  • Trading Value & MA20 in Volume Chart: Converted volume bars and stats to monetary trading value with moving average (MA20) across all assets.
  • Compact Currency Display: Added concise K tỷ, B, and T currency formatting for domestic (VN-Index) and global (S&P 500, Nikkei 225) markets.
  • Streamlined Volume Card Header: Replaced the percentage badge with the session date for a clean, stable layout without layout shift.
  • Index Precision: Removed unnecessary currency and PTS prefixes from index prices and 52-week ranges.
  • Holding Detail Parity: Added the Volume Chart Card to holding details for a consistent experience across Watchlist and Portfolio.
